name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

doNotLoadCanonicalData.description:
Determines whether or not to load data through canonicals.
Set this to `false` to load canonical data.
Set this to `true` to skip the canonical data ingestion process.

canonicalDataSyncFilesTimeout.description:
If {@link doNotLoadCanonicalData} is set to `false`, then there is a two step process
to loading the canonical data files:
1. `SourceFile#syncAll` --> Returns many {@link FileSystemBatchJob}s
2. `SourceFile#processAll` --> Starts the data ingestion process through SourceQueue

This field determines how long to wait for the first step to complete.

canonicalDataProcessFilesTimeout.description:
If {@link doNotLoadCanonicalData} is set to `false`, then there is a two step process
to loading the canonical data files:
1. `SourceFile#syncAll` --> Returns many {@link FileSystemBatchJob}s
2. `SourceFile#processAll` --> Starts the data ingestion process through SourceQueue

This field determines how long to wait for the second step to complete.

doNotLoadExcelData.description:
Asset hierarchy relational data is loaded through Excel spreadsheets. This field determines
if that data ingestion step needs to be run.
Set this to `false` to load the excel spreadsheet.
Set this to `true` to skip this step.

excelFilepath.description:
If {@link doNotLoadExcelData} is `false`, then specify the url where the excel spreadsheet
may be loaded from. If this field is left blank, then the system will try to infer the location
from the dataset generation job.

syntheticDataGenerationJob.description:
If relational data must be loaded from an excel spreadsheet created by a
{@link ReliabilitySyntheticData.ReliabilityRisk.DataGenerationJob}, specify
the job instance. The data integration workflow will extract the replicated
excel spreadsheet generated by the job automatically.

enableAsyncProcessing.description:
For performing data integration, the standard routine is to, first disable asynchronous processing
as DI is in progress, and then enable it post-DI to perform transformation of loaded data, such
as refreshing stored calculated fields or normalizing time series.
Set this to `false` to disable asynchronous processing during DI.
Set this to `true` to enable asynchronous processing during DI.

title:
Defines the specification for data integration within the reliability risk workflow.

- Manages the ingestion of canonical and non-canonical (Excel-based) asset hierarchy data.
- Controls processing timeouts and workflow dependencies.
- Ensures data consistency and transformation post-ingestion.
- Supports synthetic data integration for testing and validation.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.DataIntegration
